responsibility: Contains the loop-specific analysis and transformation logic for tree vectorization. This file drives recognition and implementation of loop vectorization features such as inductions, recurrences, reductions, masked and partial-vector execution, vector loop control, epilogues and runtime behavior specific to loops, and it rewrites eligible scalar loop bodies into vector loop form while coordinating with loop cost modeling and target vector support. As an upstream loop transform, it can change the CFG, SSA names, bounds, and memory-reference shape later consumed by object-size, range, and warning passes.
same_name_distinction: Use this file for bugs rooted in loop-vectorization analysis or transformation decisions. Use tree-vect-data-refs.cc for memory-reference classification, tree-vect-stmts.cc for statement-level vectorization, and warning/object-size/ranger files for later consumers that diagnose or reason about the transformed loop.
